title: SSH host
one_liner: Run sandboxed containers on a Linux machine you can SSH into.
when_to_use: Your own laptop, workstation, homelab or VM.

capability_notes.display: Needs the display image on the host; the Screen button offers to build it.
capability_notes.gpu: If the host has a GPU that Docker or Podman can use.
capability_notes.agents: Off until allowed in the host's sandbox defaults.

needs: An SSH alias from your SSH config, or host, user and port. Optional jump host.
A key loaded in your SSH agent, or a key file path.
Podman (rootless is fine) or Docker on the remote machine.

title: Slurm login node
one_liner: Submit batch jobs to an HPC cluster through its login node.
when_to_use: HPC or lab clusters, sweeps, scheduled work.

capability_notes.interactive_terminal: A shell on the login node, or inside a running job.
capability_notes.costs_money: Only if your site bills for cluster time.

needs: An SSH alias or host, user and port, as for an SSH host. Optional partition and work directory.
The same SSH key; if your site requires MFA, log in once in a terminal first.
sbatch, squeue, sacct and scancel on the PATH of a login shell.

title: Local Docker/Podman

capability_notes.display: Needs the display image on this computer; the Screen button offers to build it.
capability_notes.port_forward: Forwards the screen and any ports a template publishes.
capability_notes.gpu: If Docker or Podman GPU access works on this computer.
capability_notes.agents: Off until allowed in the host's sandbox defaults.

needs: No endpoint and no login: everything happens on this computer.
Docker Desktop or Podman on this computer, reachable from the command line.

title: EC2
one_liner: Start an AWS machine on demand and run containers on it like an SSH host.
when_to_use: You need more CPU than you own, for a few hours, with a time limit.

capability_notes.display: Needs about 2 GB of memory; a 1 GB instance type is too small for it.
capability_notes.gpu: Only with a GPU instance type that the AWS account's quota allows.
capability_notes.agents: Off until allowed in the host's sandbox defaults.
capability_notes.costs_money: Billed by AWS while the machine runs, and a little for its disk while it is stopped.

needs: An AWS region and an IAM user's key, stored as Hermes secrets (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY).
Nothing on a remote machine: the instance is created, given Docker and stopped for you.
One lookup of this computer's public address (checkip.amazonaws.com) for the SSH rule, unless you type it.
